recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It restores the published FHIR-32318 decision in authoritative Group source without broadening the change beyond the code system and StructureDefinition surfaces named by the issue.
issue_request: FHIR-32318 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5 and requested adding BodyStructure as an allowed Group member type both in the Group.type enumeration and in Group.member.entity Reference targets.

The later FHIR-24848 participant-pattern commit 272e3fb71ecb0d87630a48101b00015f0f18b038 replaced the Group type list and target profiles, dropping BodyStructure from current source.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes from 2022-04-25 confirm the vote to add BodyStructure. FHIR-24848 explains the later participant-pattern realignment but does not explicitly reverse FHIR-32318, and later Group work such as FHIR-52918 again allows non-participant definitional resources. source/fhir.ini keeps Group and BodyStructure in active build scope; the Group ValueSet includes the complete group-type CodeSystem and required no explicit edit.
reconciliation: Added the missing bodystructure concept with display BodyStructure to source/group/codesystem-group-type.xml, added bodystructure/BodyStructure to Group.type short and comment text, and restored BodyStructure as a Group.member.entity targetProfile in source/group/structuredefinition-Group.xml.
